en.summary: Sunday 8 November 2026: the Moon stays in Scorpio all day near 4°, a new Moon only about 1% lit. It sits close to Mercury, which is retrograde in Scorpio beside the Sun, and forms a tight square to Pluto in Aquarius. Venus, retrograde in Libra, makes a sextile to Mars and Jupiter in Leo and a trine to the North Node, while Mars remains conjunct Jupiter and opposite the North Node.

signs.belier:
Aries, shared money and intimacy ask for a clear-eyed reset today: the Moon stays in Scorpio all day near 4°, in your sector of joint resources and trust, a new Moon only about 1% lit.

Its tight square to Pluto in Aquarius stirs questions about who holds what, without asking you to force a dramatic reveal. The Moon also sits close to Mercury, retrograde in Scorpio beside the Sun, so reread a contract, a message or a private agreement before you answer. What felt buried yesterday may simply need clearer words, not a fight.

Venus, retrograde in Libra, still forms a sextile to Mars, your ruler, and to Jupiter in Leo, which gives warmth if you choose fairness over winning. Mars remains conjunct Jupiter and opposite the North Node, so generosity works better than pushing a group for status. Use this dark Moon to close one shared loop rather than open a heavier financial chapter.

The Moon sits close to Mercury, retrograde in Scorpio beside the Sun, so listen twice before you reply, especially if a past conversation is resurfacing. Venus, your ruler, is retrograde in Libra and supports a review of fairness rather than a brand-new promise.

That same Venus makes a sextile to Mars and Jupiter in Leo and a trine to the North Node, which helps you restore warmth if you stay even-handed. Mars conjunct Jupiter opposite the North Node warns against turning a private talk into a public performance. Let this nearly new Moon finish one unfinished dialogue before you demand a bigger commitment.

fr.summary: Dimanche 8 novembre 2026 : la Lune reste en Scorpion toute la journée vers 4°, une Lune nouvelle éclairée à seulement 1 % environ. Elle se trouve près de Mercure, rétrograde en Scorpion auprès du Soleil, et forme un carré serré à Pluton en Verseau. Vénus, rétrograde en Balance, forme un sextile à Mars et à Jupiter en Lion et un trigone au Nœud nord, tandis que Mars reste conjoint à Jupiter et opposé au Nœud nord.

signs.belier:

Vénus, rétrograde en Balance, forme encore un sextile à Mars, votre planète, et à Jupiter en Lion, ce qui donne de la chaleur si vous choisissez l’équité plutôt que la victoire. Mars reste conjoint à Jupiter et opposé au Nœud nord, donc la générosité sert mieux que de pousser un groupe pour le statut. Servez-vous de cette Lune sombre pour fermer une boucle partagée plutôt que d’ouvrir un chapitre financier plus lourd.
